snippet.title: Project Windless | Dev Diary: Forging the Fantasy
snippet.description:
Go behind the scenes with Krafton Montréal Studio. 
Watch as we forge a brand-new fantasy world set in the rich universe of Korea's legendary novel series, 𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐁𝐢𝐫𝐝 𝐓𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐃𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐤𝐬 𝐓𝐞𝐚𝐫𝐬.

𝐏𝐫𝐨𝐣𝐞𝐜𝐭 𝐖𝐢𝐧𝐝𝐥𝐞𝐬𝐬 is a single-player open-world action RPG where you step into a mythic age as a mighty Rekon warrior.
Journey across a breathtaking, war-torn world, stand against overwhelming odds, forge alliances, and wage war across massive battlefields to unite a fractured land and give birth to a new kingdom.

🔥𝐆𝐞𝐭 𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐥𝐚𝐭𝐞𝐬𝐭 𝐧𝐞𝐰𝐬
· 𝐎𝐟𝐟𝐢𝐜𝐢𝐚𝐥 𝐖𝐞𝐛𝐬𝐢𝐭𝐞: http://windless.krafton.com
· 𝐗: https://x.com/ProjectWindless

00:00 - Introduction
00:43 - World & Lore Origins
01:28 - Four Races of the World
02:13 - A New Fantasy Vision
03:12 - Freedom Driven Gameplay
04:27 - Combat Scale with Mass Technology
